anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet the INA219AIDCNR (U11) has pin 5 tied to NET0047 and pin 6 tied to NET0112. NET0047 is the SCL bus (it is the net on PCA9685 SCL pin 26 and EEPROM SCL pin 1) and NET0112 is the SDA bus (PCA9685 SDA pin 27, EEPROM SDA pin 2). The symbol's own text even labels pin 5 'SCL' and pin 6 'SDA'.
anomalies.expected: Per the INA219 datasheet pinout (1=VIN+, 2=VIN-, 3=GND, 4=VS, 5=SDA, 6=SCL, 7=A0, 8=A1), pin 5 must carry SDA (NET0112) and pin 6 must carry SCL (NET0047). The two I2C lines are crossed at the INA219.

evidence.quote: Power sheet, U11 INA219AIDCNR: pin 5 'SCL' -> NET0047, pin 6 'SDA' -> NET0112; note 'I2C address: 0x40'
FCCPeripherals sheet, U4 PCA9685PW: pin 26 SCL -> NET0047, pin 27 SDA -> NET0112 (defines NET0047=SCL, NET0112=SDA)

anomalies.impact: The INA219's SDA and SCL pads are swapped relative to the bus, so it will never acknowledge on the FCC I2C bus; battery voltage/current/power telemetry is lost (the rest of the bus is unaffected because the other devices are wired correctly).

parsed.summary: The board otherwise matches the specification (dual-MCU FCC/NAVC, MIC26903 buck + LD39200 LDO, PCA9685 strapped to 0x41 to avoid the documented INA219 0x40 conflict, baro RESET/EOC swap is the logged bug). The one deviation I can read off the drawing is that the INA219's I2C lines are crossed: pin 5 (datasheet SDA) is tied to the SCL net NET0047 and pin 6 (datasheet SCL) to the SDA net NET0112, which would prevent the current/voltage sensor from communicating.
